calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  d.fiscal_period_label,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_sales_incl_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
INNER JOIN fact_web_order wo ON wo.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 900
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 26
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;
